key_insights.title: Serverless Computing Goes Mainstream
key_insights.description: Serverless architecture has become the default choice for building scalable solutions with variable workloads
key_insights.evidence: Pay-as-you-go models, <5ms cold starts with edge deployment, full CI/CD integration
key_insights.notes: Chained already uses GitHub Actions (effectively serverless)

key_insights.title: Edge-to-Cloud Integration
key_insights.description: AI workloads dynamically shift between edge and cloud based on latency, privacy, and compute requirements
key_insights.evidence: Real-time inference at edge, training in cloud, privacy-sensitive processing at edge
key_insights.notes: GitHub Pages provides edge CDN automatically

key_insights.title: Kubernetes as Universal Orchestrator
key_insights.description: Kubernetes has evolved to the universal control plane for all infrastructure
key_insights.evidence: Ingress NGINX retiring March 2026, Gateway API as replacement, multi-cluster federation mature

key_insights.title: Multi-Cloud Strategies Become Standard
key_insights.description: Over 90% of organizations use multi-cloud strategies with average 2.7 providers
key_insights.evidence: Primary drivers: vendor lock-in avoidance (78%), cost optimization (65%), resilience (61%)
key_insights.notes: Chained uses GitHub as single provider, multi-AI-provider is relevant

key_insights.title: AI-Driven Cloud Operations (AIOps)
key_insights.description: AI agents automating complex workflows, remediation tasks, and infrastructure optimization
key_insights.evidence: Autonomous scaling, predictive incident prevention, automated security response
key_insights.notes: Patterns align with Chained's autonomous agent approach

key_insights.title: Platform Engineering Maturity
key_insights.description: Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) becoming foundational for scaling DevOps
key_insights.evidence: 67% of large enterprises have platform engineering teams, 3x faster developer onboarding
key_insights.notes: Conceptual parallel to workflow-based agent orchestration

key_insights.title: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Evolution
key_insights.description: IaC tools with AI-assisted configuration, automatic security remediation, multi-cloud support
key_insights.evidence: Terraform, Pulumi, Crossplane maturity; AI auto-generation and drift detection
key_insights.notes: YAML workflows are IaC-like, limited direct applicability

patterns.name: Autonomous Infrastructure Operations
patterns.description: AI agents manage scaling, remediation, and optimization autonomously

patterns.name: Abstraction of Complexity
patterns.description: From serverless to platform engineering, focus on business logic over infrastructure
patterns.relevance_to_chained: Medium - GitHub Actions already provides this

patterns.name: Multi-Provider Resilience
patterns.description: Using multiple providers for risk mitigation and cost optimization
patterns.relevance_to_chained: Medium - applicable to AI service providers

patterns.name: Edge-Native Architecture
patterns.description: Deploying compute to edge for latency-sensitive and privacy-preserving workloads
patterns.relevance_to_chained: Low - GitHub Pages handles edge delivery
